mathematics.first_order_kernel: Direct dual-number curved Hochschild cancellation, independent of full Kontsevich formality; tangent cubic term lies in Jac(F)_3, dimension C(N+2,3)-N^2 (10 for N=5). The 17-to-10 moduli kernel is NOT established.
mathematics.first_order_jacobi: Jacobi is unnecessary for first-order curved cancellation; all-orders second-action vanishing uses Jacobi.
mathematics.first_order_plucker_cone: At zero Poisson vertex of the affine Plucker cone over Gr(2,5), Zariski tangent dimension is 10 while cone dimension is 7. Combined with 10 cubic moduli directions: local 17-dimensional space has tangent dimension 20. First-order curved cancellation concerns the 10 infinitesimal Poisson directions at the commutative vertex, not a proved 7-dimensional categorical kernel at generic nonzero Poisson.
mathematics.second_order_plucker: For N=5 and any smooth cubic F, coefficient quadrics of Jacobi [ι_dF ξ,ι_dF ξ] generate exactly the five quadratic Plucker ideal generators of Gr(3,5). Independent proof via nondecomposable normal form, Euler irreducibility, and surjective wedge-square Pfaffian map. This is second-order ASSOCIATIVE obstruction, not complete central-pair formal moduli identification.
mathematics.tangent_pair: First-order marked central cubic pair tangent under identity-mod-epsilon graded equivalence: Λ^3 V ⊕ Jac(F)_3, dimensions 10+10=20 for N=5.
mathematics.categorical_tangent_at_commutative: Using dual-number graded MF comparison, relative Artin window, and JLLZ Theorem 4.4(2), differential from marked central cubic pairs to underlying dg Kuznetsov category HH^2 at a smooth cubic threefold is projection Λ^3 C^5 ⊕ Jac(F)_3 -> Jac(F)_3 followed by η iso. Hence exact 0 -> Λ^3 C^5 -> T_pair^1 -> HH^2(Ku(X)) -> 0, dimensions 10->20->10; does not compute generic nonzero Poisson kernel 7.
